purpose: Commit the single adjudicated readout convention. Only after this record may lens_A and lens_B be read.
definition: for a fixed (position, layer) and a fixed vocabulary entry, collect that logit across many activations and take the excess kurtosis of that distribution, then average over vocabulary entries
rejected_convention_note: this is the convention EQ1 computed

how_it_was_decided.criterion: registered in OD-015 and OA-004 before any curve existed: whichever convention's band agrees better with the rank-derived band on the positive control, by Jaccard index
how_it_was_decided.rank_band_provenance: derived by the official rank method against a matched-norm random-lens null, per OA-004
how_it_was_decided.margin: 0.714 against 0.000; the two conventions do not merely differ in degree, they point at opposite ends of the network

convention_D_curve_landmarks.near_zero_or_negative_region: layers 8 to 17, ranging from 0.0057 down to -0.2606

convention_V_curve_landmarks.shape: highest at the very first layers, no interior structure aligned with readability

honest_note_on_the_published_signature.published: near zero through the first third of the layers, increases beginning around a third of the way through the depth, and falls in the last few layers
honest_note_on_the_published_signature.what_D_actually_shows: the near-zero region sits in the MIDDLE, layers 8 to 17, not in the first third; layers 0 to 7 are around 0.5 to 1.6. The rise and the terminal fall are reproduced; the position of the flat region is not.
honest_note_on_the_published_signature.assessment: partial agreement, reported as partial rather than as a match

what_this_means_for_EQ1.permitted_reading_per_authority_section_: EQ1 reconstructed the paper's footnote incorrectly. EQ1's Q-4a FAIL is attributed to an IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT, not to the model.
what_this_means_for_EQ1.forbidden_reading_per_authority_section_: this is NOT a retraction of EQ1's FAIL; EQ1's record stands unchanged

od_012_effect.before_this_record: lens_A and lens_B may not be read
od_012_effect.the_guard_will_be_re_run_at_close: to prove every lens-reading record is later than this one

what_is_still_NOT_authorised_by_this_rec: reading lens_A or lens_B before R-2 begins
claim_ceiling: A convention commitment. It licenses no claim of any kind, and it is not a scientific result.
